title: Mahjong: 4-player tile matching with melds and scoring
description: 4 players, 144 tiles (already in registry: registry/tiles/mahjong-144.json). Wall of face-down tiles, 13-tile hands. Draw-and-discard with interrupt claims: chi (sequence from left player only), pon (triplet from any), kan (quad from any), ron (win from discard). Tsumo (win from self-draw). Concealed vs open hands affect scoring. Riichi declaration (betting on ready hand). Yaku scoring system: specific hand patterns worth different points (pinfu, tanyao, iipeiko, etc). Multiple rounds with seat winds rotating. Imperfect information: hidden hands, hidden wall. server_only for wall shuffle/draw, client_verifiable for discard/meld validation. Demonstrates: interrupt-based turn order (any player can claim a discard out of turn), complex scoring (WASM/Felt candidate), 4-player simultaneous claims with priority. Already have mahjong tiles in registry.
